children: Casper Network plans to move EVM compatibility from DevNet to public testnet in Q4 2026. The timing is an estimate for a testnet milestone, rather than a confirmed production release.

The transition advances Casper's Solidity-compatibility plans, which aim to let existing Ethereum tooling settle on Casper. Moving beyond DevNet puts that compatibility at the public testnet stage, shifting the focus from development to public testing. The announcement concerns progress toward support for Ethereum tooling, not evidence that those tools have been adopted on Casper. Actual adoption remains unestablished, so the milestone does not by itself demonstrate use beyond testing.

title: Casper Network: EVM compatibility moves to public testnet - Q4 2026
